messages:
kevin-f: FYI customer Nimbus (acct 9921) reported two invoices today with different totals but same invoice_id. One lists proration for plan upgrade, the other doesn't. Both were sent.

nina: Saw this in Sentry too. Renderer timed out at 02:41 and retry queued by job-runner. First run wrote invoice row, second run re-rendered and emitted PDF again without the proration lines.

billing-bot: invoice-service: render_attempt=2 invoice_id=INV-2026-04-11-9921 status=sent duplicate_warning=true

marta: customer is upset, they were charged the larger amount on one invoice. We need to void the incorrect charge and issue a corrected invoice + credit memo. Can we fix quickly?

cfo-amy: Finance sign-off: we should immediately issue a credit memo for the overcharge and notify CS. Approve remediation.

kevin-f: proposed immediate steps: 1) identify which PDF was paid (payment_id), 2) void duplicate unpaid invoice, 3) generate corrected invoice with proration lines included, 4) issue credit memo if payment occurred.

infra-raj: root cause looks like the renderer is not idempotent when job-runner retries after a timeout. It re-inserts line items if idempotency token missing. There's a race with the proration calculator job which finishes slightly slower.

nina: quick lookup SQL to correlate: 
```
SELECT i.id, i.invoice_id, i.total_cents, p.payment_id, r.attempt
FROM invoice_renders r
JOIN invoices i ON r.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE i.account_id = 9921 AND r.batch_date = '2026-04-11';
```

marta: can someone flag whether the customer was auto-paid? If yes, we'll push a credit immediately. CS wants a one-off apology credit covering payment processing fees too.

kevin-f: payment_id=pay_7f9a found, processed at 02:47. Looks like the higher-total invoice was the paid one.

infra-raj: mitigation: add idempotency key derived from account+billing_cycle+op to renderer, and make proration job write prologue rows before render completes. I'll open a hotfix PR and deploy to staging.

cfo-amy: prioritize hotfix to prod after staging sanity tests. Approving emergency deploy window now. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: hotfix-deploy: billing-renderer v2.1.7 started by infra-raj; window=10m

nina: I've queued a manual regenerate for acct 9921 with --force-prorations and --skip-retry-write to avoid double-insert.

kevin-f: please also create a credit memo for pay_7f9a for the delta and include processing-fee-coverage tag. Finance to approve amount.

marta: Approved. Issue credit memo and CC CS. I'll draft the customer note.

infra-raj: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/billing/+/2345 fixes idempotency & moves proration prewrite. Running staging smoke.

billing-bot: manual-regenerate job queued: job=regen-2026-04-11-9921 requested_by=kevin-f ETA=2m

nina: regen finished. New PDF includes proration lines. Old duplicate (unpaid) voided. Credit memo created for pay_7f9a: CM-2026-04-11-9921 amount=4250 cents (includes processing fee cover).

kevin-f: confirmed CS notified and customer reply queued. Closing finance ops for this thread. Will add root cause + action items to FIN-INV-358.

marta: add a smoke test: fail if multiple PDFs exist for same invoice_id in a single batch.

infra-raj: noted. Also adding retry telemetry to detect renderer timeouts that trigger replays.

cfo-amy: thanks team. Please include any P&L impact in the weekly finance digest.

kevin-f: closing thread.
